name: Five Signets for War Supplies
summary: In Ironforge, Field Marshal Snowfall trades commendation signets for supplies bound for the Grand Alliance’s war effort. You can exchange them for field rations, bandages, and combat gear to keep those serving on the home front equipped for the conflicts ahead.

sections.title: Supplying the Front
sections.body: Couriers and heroes bring Snowfall commendation signets earned through civic service. He trades them for survival rations and tactical gear bound for the fronts. Armies there need steady supplies as much as courage.

sections.title: A Pragmatic Trade
sections.body: Royal heralds offer public honor and civic standing for commendation signets. Snowfall offers another choice: five signets buy field gear, without pomp, glory, or official recognition. These goods help soldiers and volunteers stay alive as they march into hostile lands.

faq.answer: Field Marshal Snowfall is a senior Alliance military officer stationed in Ironforge. He is one of the Alliance’s primary quartermasters, gathering materials and distributing supplies to soldiers and adventurers aiding the war effort.
Alliance Commendation Signets are tokens awarded to citizens and adventurers who donate trade goods, bandages, herbs, and ores to support the Alliance’s mobilization.

faq.q: Why trade signets for supplies rather than prestige?
faq.answer: Trading signets for supplies gives you immediate, practical resources instead of civic reputation. For frontline fighters who need consumables, rations, and bandages, practical gear can matter more than ceremonial standing.

faq.q: Where does this exchange take place?
faq.answer: The exchange takes place in Ironforge. Field Marshal Snowfall stands near the war staging grounds and supply depots, coordinating shipments across Khaz Modan and beyond.
Yes. Field Marshal Snowfall authorizes more supply bundles whenever you provide five commendation signets.
No. Field Marshal Snowfall warns that trading signets directly for personal supplies grants no civic recognition or prestige with the Alliance factions. Their value comes back as physical goods.

angles.text: As an Alliance champion, you help keep troops supplied with bandages and rations for major campaigns across Azeroth.
As a dwarf, you can take pride in seeing Ironforge’s halls arm all allied races.
